_meta.purpose: Per-model serialization rules for the video-prompt slot schema. Derived from 1,155-entry corpus analysis (2026-09).

shared_params._note: API-level controls separate from prompt text. Availability varies per provider/endpoint — verify in current docs before relying on them.
shared_params.negative_prompt: separate field on most APIs (fal.ai, Replicate, ComfyUI nodes); in consumer UIs fold into prompt as 'no X' clauses
shared_params.seed: supported on most APIs for reproducibility; consumer UIs often hide it
shared_params.aspect_ratio: usually a parameter, not prompt text — but corpus shows in-prompt '9:16'/'vertical' also works as a hint
shared_params.duration_seconds: parameter on most APIs; in-prompt timestamps ([0s]-[5s]) are for beat structure, not length
shared_params.motion_strength: Pika/Kling expose motion/cfg sliders; higher = more motion, more artifacts
shared_params.camera_control: Hailuo/Runway expose structured camera params; prefer them over prompt text when available

_meta.language_notes: Kling/Seedance/Wan/Hailuo are Chinese-native models — English prompts work but Chinese can yield tighter adherence for culturally specific content. All corpus prompts are English; keep prompts English unless targeting CJK-specific scenes.
_meta.prompt_length: Consumer UIs cap ~500-2000 chars; API/production-spec models (Hailuo H3, Seedance 2.5) accept ~5000+ char structured blocks. Narrative models degrade past ~500 chars of dense prose.

veo-3.1.notes: Audio: label for sound. Dialogue as quoted speech inline. Cinematic prose; camera terms sparse (12% of corpus). Supports ingredients-to-video, first/last frame, extension.

sora-2.notes: Physics/texture-forward single-paragraph prose. Strong instruction following; multi-shot concepts OK. API deprecated 2026-09-24 — legacy only.

kling-3.0.notes: Explicit 'shot 1… shot 2…' sequences. Highest dialogue rate (32%). Storyboard controls, native audio, up to 15s.

seedance-2.5.notes: Reference grammar: @Image N, @Video N, @Audio N. <sfx> tags. Shot N blocks. Edit verbs: extend, edit, replace. Up to 30s single take.

hailuo-3.0.notes: Camera commands capitalized (Push In, Orbit, Tracking Shot) — 72% of corpus. H3 Max uses subject_definitions: + [Shot N] long-form spec blocks up to ~5000 chars.

runway-gen-4.5.notes: Camera-term dictionary style (macro, aerial, POV, dolly). Short descriptive prompts. Aleph = video editing model (edit verbs).

luma-ray-3.notes: Concise prose + camera motion. HDR output. Keyframes supported.

gemini-omni-flash-1.1.notes: Conversational generation+editing. timecode markers, IMAGE_REF, extension commands. 360p-4K.

wan-3.0.notes: Omni-Reference (multi image/video/audio refs), doc-to-video, edit mode. 480p/720p/1080p.

grok-imagine-1.5.notes: T2V+I2V, native audio, 1-15s up to 1080p. Plain descriptive prompts.

vidu-s2.notes: S2-Avatar (interactive characters), S2-Editing (reference-driven real-time edit). Template-style prompts.

pixverse-r2.notes: Real-time world model; prompts are live-steering instructions, not one-shot scene descriptions.

runway-solaris-gwm.notes: Solaris (interface world model), GWM Worlds 2 (720p/24fps continuous world). WorldPrompt genesis prompts + text-controlled camera/dialogue.

pika-2.5.notes: Short style-forward prompts. Pikaframes keyframe transitions.

ltx-video-2.5.notes: Open model; ComfyUI-native. Prompt + node params (duration, resolution) separate.

hunyuanvideo-1.5.notes: Open model; official Prompt Handbook. Descriptive prose, camera terms supported.

genres.narrative: Single flowing paragraph: shot_type + subject + action + setting + camera_move + lighting + style. Optional Audio:/dialogue.
genres.production-spec: Structured blocks: [Style]/[Scene]/[Shot N]/subject_definitions:/@refs/<sfx>/timestamps. Use for Seedance 2.x, Hailuo 3, Omni Flash, Kling 3, Wan 3.
genres.edit-command: Imperative verb + target: 'Extend the video…', 'Make it a sunset', 'Replace the background with…'. For V2V/edit models.
genres.interactive: Streaming steering instructions for real-time world models (PixVerse R2, Solaris, GWM).
